reviews.text:
We decided to use Preferred Tile when we needed a shower redone, and the reviews were excellent. We were led to believe that this was a tile store that had their own installers. They actually were subcontracting their work. We were not made aware of this until the work had already started. The employee of Preferred Tile that demoed the existing shower damaged my home in 2 places. The subcontractors damaged my freshly refinished wood floors, and a vintage rug. They dumped excess supplies in my yard multiple days, that I had to clean up, even after informing the company. The company supplied their subcontractor with the wrong tile, instead of what we had picked out. While they offered to replace it after it had been installed I felt that was wasteful and said it was fine. They damaged the walls in the bathroom, which they fixed but did not paint, so we had to buy paint and repaint ourselves. They left poor transitions from the tile to the wall and ceilings, I supplied wood to fix, which they cut too short and poorly tried to fix with caulk.

Less than 5 years after the shower was installed chunks of grout began falling out. After inspecting I found at least 15 spots in the grout where it clearly was not applied correctly and had washed away. I called the company to ask about them fixing it. He said they would order the supplies and get it fixed, though it would be a few weeks. Over 2 months later we called to ask about the status. The employee apologized that he had lost my info and was unable to contact me. Then informed me that while they would supply the labor to repair the grout, I would need to purchase the supplies. When I questioned that the grout should have lasted much longer than this, he agreed with me. The entire situation with this company has been a let down, even though I felt like I continually gave them grace. I love supporting a small family owned business but after paying nearly $4000 dollars you would think they would have more interest in taking care of their customers. Save your hard earned money, purchase your tile from another company and hire your own installer, or do it yourself.
Wayne and his guys have done several custom houses for us! Always professional and the best of the best! Highly recommend!

I'll just go to Lowes next time. The folks at Preferred seem like nice people but they let me down. My wife and I went in on Wednesday to pick out some tile. The lady was real nice and helped us. Towards the end, I pointed out that I had never done any tile work. We were planning to figure it out since we were short on time but I asked if they had any installers. She mentioned that one of their guys could possibly do it on the side. She ensured I would get a call in the next couple days. I decided to put off the project since I thought it was going to be taken care of. Come Friday morning I hadn't heard anything so I dropped by to see if they had the right number. The lady verified and told me she was having him call me that evening. I went in on Monday(today) after receiving zero communication and let them know I never heard from their guy. I only got blank faces so I just bought the basic stuff we had talked about and went to Lowes to get the rest. So here I am five days later starting a tile job I could have finished last week. I would have been perfectly happy with one call that said they weren't going to be able to schedule a time. The time frame was important because we were planning to have the place listed for sale this week.

reviews.text: This was probably the worst part of dealings with building my house. I’m not sure where to even begin, so be prepared to read a small novel. The woman my wife corresponded with seems to be clueless to much of the information. From day one, we were told 3 weeks, 3 weeks. This was the time at which my wife was told they wouldn’t put us on the work schedule to build cabinets until we were 3 weeks out. We called at 5 to be safe and again she said no, 3 weeks. We called at 3 weeks and she put us down, or at least I’d like to think we were. 3 week period is over and my wife calls and she says she has no idea if they are ready, it’s all on owners desk. Low and behold, they weren’t even started. 5 weeks later we have them ready to install. Installers come out to start and play hideous music, with nasty and foul language blasting it in our home. They also call and say our builder isn’t there to do his part and he was there. Owner calls my wife mad for no reason because he is there. No idea what that ignorance was about. We were supposed to have reinforced pull out drawers, they are not. The cabinets ended up being a little over an inch shallower then needed for our built in refrigerator so we have to add another trim strip to make it look close to correct. Drawers weren’t level, I had to fix 2 of them myself. We were supposed to have matching cove molding and it is not same as what is around the cabinets, close but not the same. You pay this kind of money you expect better quality and interaction with people. I even had some cracks in joints that weren’t filled in or fixed properly. I even recommended them before all this because of the initial meeting my wife had when they came out to measure. They never returned my co workers call. Blessing in disguise probably. Owner never even followed up after this install. Highly disappointed with this company. Good luck to those who choose to use this company. I understand there’s good and bad experiences with anything but mine here was terrible and wanted to share.

I typically do not like to leave companies bad reviews but our entire experience with T & A was horrible. We had our cabinets installed (months late) in November of 2020, moved in mid December 2020 & these flaws were there and continue to get worse. We understood that COVID could delay the process but we were continuously lied to through the the entire process. Every time we called we were told “3-4 weeks” - instead of just telling us the truth, that they didn’t know when they would be done. We even got a call saying they had started the cabinets but when our contractor went to the shop to check, the front desk didn’t know anything about it. That seemed to be the theme for the entire process. This issue ended up pushing our move in date back almost 2 months. We really didn’t want to say anything since their customer service & communication is the worst I have ever seen in my entire life but the issues were getting worse & we knew there was no way these cabinets would last us 10 years. In Feb of 2021 I sent an email with these pictures. I received a call a few weeks later asking if they could come look at the cabinets THAT DAY. Obviously that did not work with mine or my husband’s schedule so we said no & asked for another date. It is now Jan of 2022 and they have made no effort to fix these flaws. Are they cheaper than most of the competition? Yes. My advice - you get what you pay for & I would not recommend this company to my worst enemy no matter how cheap they are. I could keep going about all the issues we have had with this company.
